title: Rabbi Chiyya bar Pappa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Kamma 80a: “Rabbi Abba bar Pappa said in the name of Rabbi Chiyya bar Pappa, in the name of Rabbi Acha bar Pappa.” In Sanhedrin 34b: “From where are these words? Rabbi Chiyya bar Pappa said,” etc. In Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:1: “Rabbi Yaakov bar Zavdi in the name of Rabbi Abbahu: Over olive oil one blesses ‘Who creates the fruit of the tree.’ Rabbi Chiyya bar Pappa said before Rabbi Ze’ira: And a baraita says so.”

notes.text: The supplied ב״פ is supported as bar Pappa by the saved Davidson Bava Kamma 80b alternative chain. The supplied 80a locator is retained alongside this matching 80b location. Berakhot 6:1 is a Jerusalem Talmud locator.
